strategic_read: This domain contains the program's best infrastructure and its most important funeral. The spine is genuinely excellent: a 363GB/52M-row mathematical corpus, correctly repaired (rekey verified complete today), reachable from every machine through one clean pooled API, with the DuckDB consolidation actually finished at the data layer. Nothing else in Prometheus is this solid. But every consumer built on top of it died honestly: Theseus proved it can emit 658M records and simultaneously that zero of them replay as promotable; the greedy LoRA — the program's only completed training run — was dismantled by its own ablation into format-following plus a False prior plus template memorization, with a measured reasoning share of ~0.10 that transfers nowhere. The June diagnostics all converge on one sentence from TRAINING_DATA_SURVEY: the substrate stores verdicts and throws away derivations (step_trace is null everywhere). That is Harmonia's 'the stall is representational/interface, not epistemic' made concrete in the data layer. Implications: (1) do not restart the Theseus loop as-is — its volume thesis is dead and rerunning it manufactures more unmappable exhaust; (2) the next data investment should be the already-diagnosed TIER-1 build (worked computation traces from prometheus_math tests, OEIS executable programs, battery cascades) plus the step_trace retrofit, because that is the one direction the June kills did NOT rule out; (3) the estate is a single-box, zero-backup liability holding the program's only irreplaceable asset — a backup/dump of fire+sci (lmfdb is re-cloneable) is cheap insurance that nobody has bought; (4) resolve the bus fork (empty PgRedis vs M4's Redis project) before any multi-agent revival, or comms will fracture again; (5) the buried gems (4.76M-object tensor, Talos corpus, OOD eval harness) are exactly the representational assets a Learner-eval-first restart would want — inventory them into whatever plan the 08-12 resumed sessions produce, or they stay buried.
